authority_ceiling: below host, system, developer, user, repository protection, and promotion authority
purpose: Persist explicit bounded self-prompt cycles in Git so agents can finish one cycle, commit work, rehydrate exact shared state, and continue across turns or agents.

transitions: ACTIVE -> ACTIVE: observed completion + descendant work head + remaining budget
ACTIVE -> COMPLETE: observed SUCCEEDED completion with terminal=true
ACTIVE -> HOLD_NO_PROGRESS: no-progress ceiling or explicit non-failure hard hold
ACTIVE -> ABORTED: observed FAILED completion with hard_hold=true

cycle: hydrate exact prompt and optional SCHED frontier coordinates
submit observed completion and deliberation pass receipts
verify exact checkpoint ancestry and state/prompt digests
persist receipt, state and the next prompt in a CAS Git commit
optionally publish and freshly verify the shared remote frontier
resume explicitly in a later turn or agent

remote_modes.REQUIRED: fresh sync and post-write publication verification are mandatory
remote_modes.BEST_EFFORT: local progress is allowed but never represented as durable shared return

invariants: one loop checkpoint is current per loop
advance requires the current checkpoint to be an ancestor of the work head
manual changes to state or prompt fail digest verification
SUCCEEDED and PARTIAL completions contain every required deliberation pass
local commit and shared publication remain separate states
loop verification establishes causal integrity, not world truth
